lessons.title: Drive File ID is execution authority; FUSE is convenience
lessons.source_event: Existing-runtime bundle pattern and W01/W02 v1.1.5.2 custody incident
lessons.root_cause: Mounted-path visibility was treated too close to server custody
lessons.policy_change: For existing Drive inputs use File ID authority; FUSE only as optional fast path and always SHA verify

lessons.title: FUSE read-back does not prove a new Drive object exists
lessons.source_event: v1.1.5.2 mounted copy had exact SHA while Drive API listed only v1.1.5.1
lessons.root_cause: Local/FUSE cache visibility was conflated with Drive server object creation
lessons.policy_change: New artifact is staged only after Drive File ID + API re-download + SHA/parent verification

lessons.title: Drive warnings and write failures must be classified differently
lessons.source_event: httplib2 timeout warning coexisted with successful auth; userRateLimitExceeded blocked create
lessons.root_cause: Warnings/errors were not initially separated by effect
lessons.policy_change: Ignore harmless timeout warning only when operation succeeds; treat userRateLimitExceeded as material write failure

lessons.title: Resume from last proven gate; do not restart successful Colab phases
lessons.source_event: CELL02 failures occurred after CELL00/CELL01 had passed
lessons.root_cause: Failure encouraged unnecessary restart risk
lessons.policy_change: Preserve prior receipts and rerun only smallest affected phase

lessons.title: A failing test is not automatically a Product defect
lessons.source_event: CELL02 mixed orchestration, ordering, Product, stale-test and envelope failures
lessons.root_cause: Failure class was initially ambiguous
lessons.policy_change: Directly inspect implementation/test/log and classify before mutation

lessons.title: PostgreSQL database lifecycle commands must be isolated
lessons.source_event: CELL02 combined DROP/CREATE DATABASE in one psql -c and failed
lessons.root_cause: Database lifecycle commands conflicted with transaction context
lessons.policy_change: Separate terminate/drop/create role/DB calls and add authenticated connection probes

lessons.title: Expected hash gates themselves require independent verification
lessons.source_event: Literal hotfix produced da9e28... while expected hash was for a differently formatted local patch
lessons.root_cause: Control hash was not computed from the exact user-visible patch
lessons.policy_change: Reproduce literal patch bytes; use old/new hash + semantic markers + compile

lessons.title: Build prerequisites must precede tests that render built assets
lessons.source_event: Laravel tests failed because Vite manifest did not exist; npm build later passed
lessons.root_cause: Test execution order ignored generated asset dependency
lessons.policy_change: Build before page-render suites and verify manifest presence

lessons.title: Typecheck failures can mix Product defects and stale test fixtures
lessons.source_event: Three TypeScript errors spanned two Product files and one test fixture
lessons.root_cause: Typecheck output was treated as one class
lessons.policy_change: Classify each failing file against current contract before patching

lessons.title: Do not degrade correct Product semantics to satisfy stale tests
lessons.source_event: toggle->paragraph, slash-menu and VS001 tests encoded older assumptions
lessons.root_cause: Tests outlived contract/UI evolution
lessons.policy_change: Verify current direct contract then align test when Product is correct

lessons.title: Async UI tests must await application state settlement
lessons.source_event: RQ pin click completed trigger before Promise.all detail fetch settled
lessons.root_cause: Event dispatch completion confused with workflow completion
lessons.policy_change: Use flushPromises/equivalent and assert final application state

lessons.title: Positional DOM selectors are brittle in compositional shells
lessons.source_event: Workspace presentation select shifted RQ source select positions
lessons.root_cause: Tests targeted order instead of semantic identity
lessons.policy_change: Select controls by stable semantic contract/labels/options and assert exact cardinality

lessons.title: Test fixtures must satisfy the current validation contract
lessons.source_event: VS001/VS002 fixtures omitted required block depth
lessons.root_cause: Historical payload fixtures were retained
lessons.policy_change: Regenerate/align fixtures from current validation/public contract

lessons.title: Hard-coded inventory counts must be verified against exact universe
lessons.source_event: Migration lifecycle expected 12 while candidate had 13
lessons.root_cause: Static count drift
lessons.policy_change: Count exact governed inventory first, then align expectation or replace with invariant when appropriate

lessons.title: Repository-envelope test failures are distinct from portable Product failures
lessons.source_event: Architecture suite expected review-packets, parent AGENTS.md and git root absent from candidate
lessons.root_cause: Suite assumed full repository envelope
lessons.policy_change: Classify envelope dependency separately and run in intended repository context

lessons.title: Preserve real findings inside partially environment-bound suites
lessons.source_event: Module boundary finding appeared alongside RepositorySafety envelope failures
lessons.root_cause: Broad environmental dismissal could hide real Product issue
lessons.policy_change: Adjudicate each architecture failure independently

lessons.title: Runtime-discovered corrections create a new candidate lineage identity
lessons.source_event: C025 corrections were applied to disposable v1.1.5.1 source
lessons.root_cause: Old candidate could be incorrectly used for browser proof
lessons.policy_change: Package a bounded successor and bind all later evidence to successor identity

lessons.title: Build successors from clean predecessor plus exact admitted overlay
lessons.source_event: v1.1.5.2 was reconstructed from clean v1.1.5.1 and exactly nine changed files
lessons.root_cause: Packaging mutated working tree could include generated/unintended changes
lessons.policy_change: Re-extract predecessor, reproduce tree, overlay admitted files, prove exact delta

lessons.title: Source identity and ZIP container identity are different but both matter
lessons.source_event: Repacking identical source produced same source tree/manifest but a different ZIP SHA
lessons.root_cause: Compression/runtime can vary container bytes
lessons.policy_change: Use tree+source manifest for content identity and exact ZIP SHA+File ID for execution custody; never silently substitute containers

lessons.title: No browser evidence on a disposable mutated predecessor
lessons.source_event: C025 passed on corrected working source before successor Drive custody existed
lessons.root_cause: Browser could have become bound to non-governed bytes
lessons.policy_change: Block browser until exact successor is packaged, Drive-custodied, freshly bootstrapped and reverified

lessons.title: One cell at a time is a governance control, not a convenience
lessons.source_event: C025 required several bounded diagnostics/corrections
lessons.root_cause: Run-all would blur causal evidence and repeat successful work
lessons.policy_change: Execute phased cells and inspect receipts/logs between gates
